Aditya — thanks for the forward. I did an initial tax-document validation. Notes below:

- W-8BEN-E (v1): Part I — the form is completed, but Line 6 (U.S. TIN) is blank. For a foreign entity receiving US-sourced payments routed via a US entity, we need either a US EIN in Part I or documentation that payments are treaty-exempt with supporting FATCA classification.
- Signature block: appears signed by "Sara Jones" but the title isn't clearly an authorized officer. We need a Statement of Authority or an officer-signed cover letter that indicates signatory capacity.
- Certificate of Incorporation is present and matches the legal name, good.

What I need from the vendor to clear the tax hold: either a) a corrected W-8BEN-E with a US EIN entered in Part I and signed by an authorized officer, or b) a FATCA classification letter and an officer-signed authority letter explaining payment routing and tax withholding responsibilities.

Temporary operational step: I've raised a conditional PO (PO R-23456) in our procurement system with the hold reason "tax-evidence" so we can track invoices while evidence is outstanding. I've attached the conditional PO stub for your reference. Once we receive the corrected docs, Finance will remove the hold and mark PO R-23456 active.

Attachments: PO_R-23456_conditional.pdf (application/pdf), Tax_Onboarding_Checklist_BrightScale.pdf (application/pdf)
